description: Total gross electricity required by state consumers throughout the fiscal year.

description: Total energy delivered to the state distribution systems.

description: Daily total precipitation interpolated from nationwide rain-gauge network onto a 0.25° x 0.25° terrestrial grid.

description: Daily calendar index for gridded rainfall time slice.

description: Total replenishable groundwater available for extraction after natural discharge accounting.

description: Combined annual draft for domestic, industrial, and agricultural irrigation extraction.

description: Extraction stage: Safe (<70%), Semi-Critical (70-90%), Critical (90-100%), Over-Exploited (>100%).
provenance_notes: CGWB 2025 categorization. Determines CGWA statutory NOC permissibility.

description: Maximum 2-meter air temperature over the diurnal cycle. Primary driver of peak chiller electricity and cooling degree days.
provenance_notes: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis state-level daily aggregate.

description: Mean 2-meter air temperature across the 24-hour period.
provenance_notes: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis.

description: Dewpoint temperature; combined with ambient dry-bulb temperature defines wet-bulb temperature and evaporative cooling tower approach limits.
provenance_notes: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis.

description: Daily accumulated surface solar irradiance. Governs building envelope thermal load and regional solar PV generation offset.
provenance_notes: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis.

description: Bio-meteorological thermal stress index integrating temperature, wind, humidity and radiant heat. Strong correlation with state air-conditioning surge.
provenance_notes: ECMWF ERA5-derived UTCI bioclimatic dataset.

description: Daily maximum 2-meter air temperature specifically geolocated to Pune datacenter cluster (18.52° N, 73.86° E).
provenance_notes: NASA POWER Daily Point API (MERRA-2 0.5° assimilation).

description: Daily average relative humidity. High RH suppresses evaporative cooling efficiency and forces mechanical chiller staging.
provenance_notes: NASA POWER Daily Point API.

description: Daily surface solar insolation for rooftop/campus solar capacity modeling.
provenance_notes: NASA POWER / CERES SYN1deg satellite radiometer.

description: Design or contracted IT electrical capacity of the operational or under-construction data center campus. NOT time-series consumption.

description: Binary flag indicating whether facility is situated in a high/critical baseline water-stressed basin or over-exploited taluka.

description: Verified boundary polygon coordinates for site campus parcel.
provenance_notes: Data Center Atlas Verified Construction Core v0.17.

description: Annual facility water consumption divided by annual IT equipment energy consumption.

description: Gross annual water volume consumed (evaporated or incorporated) by data centre cooling infrastructure.
provenance_notes: Operator public ESG sustainability reports.
